name: Yuugao Hazuki
source:
She is the chief warden of the "Serious Crime Section", the most hierarchical of the guards.
Known as the "Queen Bee" to those around her, she practically holds the reigns of the prison.
She has no hesitation in tormenting others, and has a strong sense of cruelty.
